model: Model: conformal mapping for coplanar waveguide with a lower ground plane (Wadell, Transmission Line Design Handbook, 1991, s3.4; Simons, Coplanar Waveguide Circuits, 2001, s2.4), with the conductor-thickness correction of Gupta et al. (Microstrip Lines and Slotlines, 2nd ed., s7.3): the strip widens and the gap narrows by delta = (1.25 t / pi) (1 + ln(4 pi w / t)), and the air part of the field grows with t / gap. Solder mask is ignored (it lowers Z0 by about 1-2 ohm).
